items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: You know the people after me... were still getting jobs with Woody Herman

ctx.x: You know the people after me, except maybe four or five years after me, were still getting jobs with Woody Herman and, you know Buddy Rich and Maynard Ferguson lasted a lot longer. But the young people today, they don’t get to play, really they can play with a pop star if they’re lucky to get a gig with them. And you know they play a few other things, but I mean we were playing all the time: dinner theaters, you know, all kinds of stuff. So you know that’s why it’s important — see I never played in Lexington very…
Oh Vince, I never thought of that.
